steps.note: Sent by OpenTelemetry inside the kit with no code: ASP.NET Core, HttpClient and Npgsql traces, metrics every 15 seconds, and logs. The body is OTLP protobuf (not shown); a JSON export is answered {} instead.
Queued in memory and sent in batches of at most 100, about once a second. It never blocks, and never throws once the name is valid. Use it for what the app itself means.
The body names no app: the intake attributes every event, trace, metric and log to the app by its token. Values illustrative.

variations.title: The event name is not lowercase dotted words

output: System.ArgumentException: Event name 'NoteCreated' must be lowercase dot-separated words (e.g. 'note.created'). (Parameter 'name')
steps.note: The one way Track throws: at once, where it is written.

body.title: The request is not valid
body.detail: An event's properties are at most 8192 bytes.

steps.note: Other refusals: "At most 100 events per request." and "userId is at most 100 characters."

output: Endgame telemetry: 1 custom event(s) could not be sent and were dropped: The platform answered POST platform/v1/telemetry/events with 400: An event's properties are at most 8192 bytes.
steps.note: The batch is dropped, not retried, and the request that tracked it is never affected.

body.title: Too large
body.detail: An export is at most 4194304 bytes.

steps.note: 4 MB is the shipped limit (Telemetry:MaxBodyBytes). A signal other than traces, metrics or logs gets 404 "The OTLP signals are traces, metrics and logs."
